question: Trace the advanced-node (<=5 nm) semiconductor supply chain and its control surface end-to-end. Cover: (a) the single-source chokepoints — ASML (Veldhoven) as the sole EUV lithography supplier, and the subordinate inputs it depends on (Zeiss SMT optics, Trumpf CO2 lasers, Cymer LPP light sources); the TSMC concentration of advanced-node logic fabs (Hsinchu, Tainan, Kaohsiung) and the handful of end customers (Apple, Nvidia, AMD, Qualcomm, Broadcom); (b) the named fab projects actively under CHIPS Act / EU Chips Act / Japan METI funding — TSMC Arizona (Fab 21 Phases 1-3), TSMC Kumamoto (JASM Phase 1 and 2), TSMC Dresden (ESMC), Intel Ohio One, Samsung Taylor, Micron Idaho, Rapidus Chitose IIM-1, Intel Magdeburg — with owners, JV partners, government funding amounts, and announced production timelines; (c) the ownership structures — TSMC shareholder base (National Development Fund of Taiwan, BlackRock, Vanguard, ADR holders), Intel government-equity quasi-investor relationship after CHIPS Act, Samsung Electronics cross-holding via Samsung C&T and the Lee family, ASML major holders, Rapidus as an asset-contribution JV (Toyota, Sony, SoftBank, NEC, Denso, Kioxia, NTT, MUFG), JASM as TSMC/Sony/Denso/Toyota JV; (d) the recent and ongoing corporate events in the industry — GlobalFoundries 2009 spinout from AMD (asset_contribution), Tower Semiconductor merger-into Intel attempt (failed 2023), Samsung Display spinoff, IBM Microelectronics divested_to GlobalFoundries, Applied Materials / Tokyo Electron attempted merger; (e) the overlapping export-control regimes that actors and products are subject_to or exposed_to — US EAR Foreign Direct Product Rule, US Commerce Entity List, US BIS October 7 2022 and October 17 2023 rules, Dutch NP (National Permit) Instrument on ASML, Japan METI export controls on 23 categories of chip-making gear, Korea strategic-goods export rules — and which regimes mitigate each other via 123-style side letters or carve-outs; (f) the benchmark and price reporting layer — which agencies publish reference prices for wafer ASP, DRAM contract / spot, NAND contract / spot, mature-node foundry pricing (TrendForce, DIGITIMES, IDC, IC Insights, Gartner, SEMI). Name all key individuals where known (Morris Chang, Mark Liu, C.C. Wei, Peter Wennink / Christophe Fouquet at ASML, Pat Gelsinger, Jensen Huang, Lisa Su) and the sanctioned / restricted Chinese counterparties (SMIC, YMTC, CXMT, Huawei / HiSilicon). Separate verified facts from hypotheses; mark explicitly what requires fresh web_search to verify (project timelines, stake percentages, dollar grants).
